decision: Add one continuing Norient publication and research collection and one dated residency application deadline, using original publisher URLs rather than the aggregator.

resource.name: Norient: Sound, Culture and Research
resource.description: Independent Swiss publishing and curatorial platform examining music, sound and cultural life through essays, podcasts, films, photography and research. Its collections include Norient City Sounds, TIMEZONES and the Norient Academic Online Journal archive, with named contributors and editors. Public material coexists with paid membership for archive search and selected digital publications; books and event participation have separate terms.

resource.audit_note: Official About, digital publications, academic archive, membership and 2027 residency call inspected. Current operation supported by dated 2026 collections and the organizer-linked 2027 application form. An independent mixed-format publisher and research reference, not a university or a claim that every contribution is peer reviewed. Historical journal material remains an archive; no current journal issue schedule assumed. Membership is required for archive search and some digital publications; do not describe the entire site as freely accessible. No blanket reuse license established; check each author, recording, image and publication. Planned Manuals for the Future is not yet a completed publication. The first 2027 Forum is not assumed to be annual. No third-party texts, images or audio copied.

event.name: Norient Forum 2027 Residencies: Application Deadline
event.description: Deadline for two selected residencies in Bern, Switzerland, March 1-19, 2027. Open worldwide to applicants under 35 working with music, sound or noise through writing, podcasts, film, photography or other media; English-language Forum. Travel and shared accommodation covered, plus CHF 2,000 for both the residency and approximately two additional working weeks remotely. Residents co-host the March 11-13 Forum and co-produce Manuals for the Future, planned for September 2027. Apply with a CV, short bio, one-minute video and a PDF with up to three work samples. Deadline time and time zone unspecified; meals, visa costs and insurance coverage not established.
event.source: Norient official 2027 call and organizer-linked application form verified 2026-11-09. https://form.jotform.com/263065146193053 Notification December 23, 2026. No application submitted. Funding is stated by component rather than described as all expenses paid; project ownership and publication terms require organizer clarification.
